footnotes: Fiscal 2026 had 53 weeks (ended Sep 3, 2026); fiscal 2025 had 52 weeks (ended Aug 28, 2025). First-half revenue is total revenue less FQ3 and FQ4 (calculated).

Net income includes $60M of equity-method income. Free cash flow = operating cash flow − expenditures for property, plant & equipment (calculated; Micron's own adjusted measure nets out partner contributions and was $62.3B).
Diluted EPS by quarter as reported in the 10-Qs; fourth quarters are calculated (net income ÷ estimated diluted shares) because EPS does not add across quarters.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Micron's revenue rose 3.6 times to $133.2B in fiscal 2026 (53 weeks ended September 3, 2026), with the fourth quarter alone bringing in $54.2B. Gross margin jumped to 80.7% from 39.8%, and operating income rose ten-fold to $99.3B.

Net income was $85.0B, or $74.33 per diluted share. Operating cash flow reached $89.7B even after $30.7B of capital spending, and Micron finished the year with $73.5B of cash and investments against $5.2B of debt.
highlights: Quarterly revenue climbed from $11.3B a year earlier to $54.2B in FQ4.
Debt fell 64.5% to $5.2B, leaving $68.3B of net cash.
FQ1 FY2027 revenue is guided to $61.5B, plus or minus $1.5B.
watch: Memory is a cyclical business, and current margins are far above Micron's history.
Fiscal 2026 had one more week than fiscal 2025.
Tax expense rose to $14.8B as profits surged.
sources: Micron fiscal Q4 and FY2026 results (SEC 8-K)
